description: This file defines a PHP class 'Sass' within the Opencart admin controller namespace. The class is responsible for generating a compiled CSS file from a SASS (.scss) file within the admin view directory. It includes methods to load language resources, verify the existence of source files, compile SASS to CSS using the ScssPhp compiler, and write the output CSS to the filesystem.

classes.name: Sass
classes.description: Controller class responsible for compiling SASS files into CSS in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a CSS file from the corresponding SASS file if it exists; returns success or error message.
